source_snapshot.title: Diwali in UAE: Dubai communities ban fireworks, warn residents about candles and diyas
source_snapshot.text: Residents in Dubai's Emaar-managed communities have been reminded that setting off fireworks during Diwali celebrations is strictly prohibited. The community management has also issued safety guidelines for lighting candles and diyas at home, urging residents to follow the rules to prevent fire hazards during the festivities.In a notice dated November 6, Emaar Community Management said the fireworks ban was in accordance with local authority regulations. Residents were asked to cooperate to ensure a safe and enjoyable celebration for everyone..Get updated faster and for FREE: Download the Gulf News app now - simply click here..Candle and diya safety rulesResidents have also been advised to exercise caution when lighting candles and diyas inside their homes. The notice outlines the following precautions:Keep candles and diyas away from flammable materials.Never leave lit candles or diyas unattended.Do not light candles or diyas in common areas, as this is strictly prohibited.Safety reminder for DiwaliResidents are urged to follow the community guidelines and take the necessary precautions when celebrating Diwali. The reminders aim to prevent fire hazards and ensure a safe celebration for everyone.Emaar Community Management concluded its notice by wishing residents a happy and safe Diwali..Diwali 2026 in the UAE: Festivals, temples and where to celebrate.Dubai Police warns Eid fireworks can cause deadly injuries.Sharjah warns illegal fireworks can lead to jail and Dh1 million fine under UAE law.Dh100,000 fine, one-year jail for illegal fireworks in UAE

claims.claim: In Dubai's Emaar-managed residential complexes, fireworks are banned during Diwali celebrations.
The ban on fireworks is introduced according to local regulations to ensure residents' safety.
Residents are advised to follow safety precautions when lighting candles and diyas at home: keep them away from flammable materials, do not leave them unattended, and do not use them in common areas.
Emaar Community Management wished everyone a safe and happy Diwali.

title: Diwali in UAE: Dubai communities ban fireworks, warn residents about candles and diyas
summary_ru: 🎆 В Дубае запретили фейерверки на Дивали В жилых комплексах, управляемых Emaar, запрещено запускать фейерверки во время празднования Дивали. Запрет введён согласно местным правилам, чтобы обеспечить безопасность жителей. 📍 Жителям рекомендовали соблюдать меры предосторожности при зажигании свечей и диаев дома: держать их подальше от горючих материалов, не оставлять без присмотра и не использовать в общих зонах. Emaar Community Management пожелала всем безопасного и счастливого праздника.
